unsupported_categories.reason: Rust union field access resolution is not implemented in the syntax-only model
unsafe is a Rust language construct; C has no equivalent category
Implicit compiler conversions have no CSTYLE_CAST_EXPR source node and are outside pointer_conversion
pointer_conversion requires a pointer target; explicit pointer-to-integer casts are documented as outside the category
Macro-expanded casts are retained separately and are not included in pointer_conversion
Operations whose spelling location is a third-party macro definition are excluded from project counts; the invocation provenance is retained on descriptive records
Unless a narrowly specified addr_of!/addr_of_mut! form is modelled, macro contents remain unresolved rather than being treated as zero operations
